name: Abdulrahman Zidan
title: Computer Science Engineering student
intro: I’m Abdulrahman, a Computer Science Engineering student connecting security thinking with networks, systems and the software built on top of them.
about: My focus is cybersecurity. My curiosity extends across the stack: how a network communicates, how an operating system behaves, and how software can make a complex problem easier to understand. I’m building a body of work that makes those connections visible.
